results.question: Do creatures phasing back in trigger enter the battlefield abilities?
results.text: No. A permanent phasing in doesn’t trigger enters-the-battlefield abilities because phasing isn't a zone change and zone-change triggers don’t trigger when a permanent phases in or out. Phasing is a static ability that causes certain permanents to phase out during the untap step and phased-out permanents that phased out under that player’s control to phase in (the game treats a permanent that phases in as “phased in” and as though it exists again) [702.26a, 702.26c]. However, phasing doesn’t move a permanent between zones, and “zone-change triggers” (including enters-the-battlefield triggers) don’t trigger when a permanent phases in or out [702.26d; 603.6a]. Note one related exception: abilities that trigger when a permanent phases out are treated specially and look back in time to see if they trigger; that exception applies to phasing-out triggers, not to enters-the-battlefield triggers when a permanent phases in [603.10b]. Also, triggered abilities that trigger when a permanent becomes attached or unattached don’t trigger because of phasing in or out [702.26j].
